t.zh: 到这里，?-字母都在等式左边。可要对上的两句都可能带着 ?，这时会出现「下雨 ≐ ?B」这样 ? 在右边的等式，而现有的元件只认左边的 ?。新元件「定向」把它翻成 ?B ≐ 下雨。
t.en: So far the ?-letters have all been on the left. But both sentences being fitted may hold them, and then an equation like “it rains ≐ ?B” appears, its ?-letter on the right, where the parts so far do not look. A new part, “Orient”, turns it into ?B ≐ it rains.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手：把每组等式解到底；对不上的，说「失败」。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that solves each set of equations to the end, or says “failed” when they do not fit.

hint.zh: ?-字母在右边的等式，先翻过来。
hint.en: Turn round any equation with its ?-letter on the right.
